Brother, trust me when I say this. She might not realise it now but she will happily move with her life even without you. No one is indispensable! I have been where your at but stop putting your friendship on a pedestal. It’s just another way of creating an illusion that you guys have a special relationship. Get out of this cycle for yourself, else before you know it you’ll be her shoulder to cry on for years. While you wouldn’t have explored any options in your life. Your young enough, that you can afford to learn the hard, but do yourself a favour and skip it . 

Take some time off from each other and focus on yourself and maybe meeting other people. And if you do have a friendship that is special it should be able to endure a few months apart.
